svg.text: boat cave with a rusted gate
A plain round hill made legible by people: stepped walls,
an incline rail, cisterns, all being swallowed by figs and flowers.

g.text: Ground level: terrace wall, fig roots over a doorway.

svg.text: View from the pod, looking west (south ← → north), with the reef wreck's mast in front. Below the water: cutaway, depth compressed.
